title: A cloud run that needs a person mid-run without a Telegram question has no alert path
body: The alert evaluator runs on local snapshot pushes and on the cloud Run Workflow's finalize, and a cloud run's 'needs a person' attention comes from the room's pending gates — which already page Telegram when the orchestrator registered them with notify: telegram. But a cloud run that holds for a person in any way that does not carry a notify=telegram question appears on the /status page and nowhere in the alerts. A per-project evaluation pass (the hourly cron trigger the sweeps and digest already ride) over the composed cloud documents would close that with the same per-stop dedup.
